desc: Read the input values $N$, $S$, and $T$ from standard input.
Build the `mapping` dictionary. If a conflict is found (same source char maps to different target chars), print -1.
Identify the set of characters present in $S$.
Detect cycles in the mapping restricted to these characters using DFS.
If a cycle is detected, print -1.
If valid, count the number of characters $c$ in $S$ such that `mapping[c] != c`.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., $N=1$, $S=T$, $S$ and $T$ completely disjoint) are handled.
